report:
Reassessed the complete claim, sole ordinary implementation association sage_ir::external_syms, and sole associated test sage_meta::todo::symbols_external_fact_queries. Independently compared both current external_syms.rs and representation_spec.rs byte-for-byte with the historical input: both are exact matches. This corroborates unchanged evidence, not an inherited approval.

Source inspection: external_trait_signature, external_adt_signature, external_impl_signature, external_fn_signature and associated-type queries identify external definitions by crate number/definition index and consume raw results into owned Stashed Sage signatures, predicates, binders and types. Item/candidate queries similarly lower raw identities into Sage symbols, keeping candidate discovery separate from signature retrieval. lower_ty preserves associated projections as Sage AliasTy values rather than asking the provider to normalize them; lower_predicate constructs Sage predicates rather than provider proofs. These are concrete examples of the requested import boundary. The external ADT/name method lookup concerns external members, not Sage-local name resolution. This file alone does not prove the global exclusion of provider-local resolution, proof, normalization or unrelated metadata reads, nor full body-query behavior.

The complete associated test set consists of the explicit TODO function; its empty body contains no behavioral assertions. Its comment reserves definition-keyed signature/body/proof/normalization traces and rejection of unrelated metadata reads. This is an adequate visible deferral of end-to-end verification for all remaining claim aspects, not evidence they already work. Prerequisites are complete corresponding query/consumer paths and instrumented metadata fixtures that can distinguish the requested definition/fact from unrelated reads and verify Sage-side resolution/proof/normalization on imported values. The incidental unassociated missing-inherent-metadata test in the implementation file asserts empty/incomplete candidates only and does not close this gap. No N/A evidence exists. The historical rationale remains sufficient with these explicit limits; no edits requested.

Execution: personally ran review start and exact source comparisons, inspected all current initial fragments, then recorded this report. No behavioral tests or workspace build were run by this reviewer. Coordinator-reported build and 321 passing sage-meta tests are separate execution evidence and do not discharge the TODO. No additional implementation dependencies were used to claim completeness beyond the captured file.
